queries.production: SELECT batch_id, product, line, planned_qty, actual_qty, started_at, finished_at FROM production WHERE date(started_at) = :report_date
queries.quality: SELECT batch_id, product, item, value, unit, direction, limit_value, standard, limit_source, tested_at, inspector, lab FROM quality WHERE date(tested_at) = :report_date
